==Usage==
Copy-paste the following code and replace "NUMBER" with the appropriate issue number.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>BuildFalconDates|''NUMBER''}}

===Example===
 <nowiki>{{BuildFalconDates|75}}</nowiki>
*{{BuildFalconDates|75}}
